title: Drunk-driving Latvian welfare minister out of detention
summary_full: No preventive measure has been imposed on the former Minister for Welfare, Reinis Uzulnieks (ZZS), who was caught driving while heavily intoxicated, but he could face up to one year’s imprisonment for the offence, the LETA news agency has learnt.
